packages.name: YouTube Experiment Settings
packages.description: Add controls for YouTube's experimental features.

packages.name: Video Quality Controls
packages.description: Choose default video quality for Wi-Fi and mobile data.

limitations.title: No Push, Widgets or Share Sheet
Try New Releases First

catalog.name: Reddit · Kiwi
catalog.subtitle: Reddit with ad removal
catalog.description: Built privately from the original App Store app and pinned RedditFilter sources. Promoted feed posts and comment ads are hidden by default. Extra filters are available under Profile → Settings → RedditFilter. Sign in using Other options → Log in with browser on the email or username login screen, or use an emailed login link. Each release records its patch recipe.

packages.name: RedditFilter
packages.description: Removes promoted posts and comment ads by default. Includes sideload sign-in fixes and optional filters in Reddit's settings.

limitations.title: Sign In with Browser or Email Link
limitations.detail: On the email or username login screen, tap Other options → Log in with browser, or paste an emailed login link. Use your Reddit username and password; Google sign-in may fail.

limitations.title: No Push, Widgets or Share Sheet
Follows RedditFilter
limitations.detail: Builds the Reddit version supported by the pinned tweak. Newer versions follow after a compatibility update.
